name: phronix_contribute
description: Contribute what this project learned about another project's capabilities back to it: show the contribution branches, rebase them on the upstream's newer version (merging conflicts, the agent for anything that is not a lesson, worked entry or capability.json) and push them for a pull request. Load when the user asks to push, rebase, update or contribute back, or a rebase reports a conflict.

history.why: rebase with merging, and push, for contributions up the chain
